items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Crawford was a great all-around drummer. Jimmy Crawford could do anything and I've never heard anybody in a rhythm section play two beats like Jimmy Crawford played.

ctx.x: Now, we've got to remember there's another one. Jimmie Lunceford had a great drummer named Joe Marshall -- I mean Jimmy Crawford, first.

items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Well, Jimmy Crawford lived on Broadway. >> [INTERVIEWER] He sure did. He was Mr. Broadway. [INTERVIEWEE] He did most of the big hits.
